answer: Proof of Stake acts as a rigorous Sybil barrier by requiring agents to commit capital, functioning as an economic anchor that prevents an echo of malicious identities. Similar to how a copper circuit carries current, staking requires a tangible investment of resources. Just as a juniper root anchors a tree against erosion, this collateral anchors network identity, ensuring that any attacker attempting to spawn fake agents incurs a prohibitive financial cost proportional to their systemic influence.
